name: 2026 European Winter Meeting of the Econometric Society
organizer: Econometric Society; hosted by the University of Warsaw
submission_requirements: Paper as PDF via Oxford Abstracts; each person may submit and present only one paper (may co-author several). Open to all; Best Paper Awards limited to papers whose authors are all within two years of PhD. Program chair: Kalina Manova (UCL)
membership_required: At least one author of each submitted paper must be an Econometric Society member
keynotes: Mar Reguant (BSE and Northwestern); Andreas Moxnes (BI Norwegian Business School); Beata Javorcik (EBRD and Oxford) - ECB European Economic Policy Lecture
